label: Dissociation Between Peripheral Muscle Strength and Exercise Capacity in Symptomatic Post-COVID-19 Individuals: Implications for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation.
summary: Infection with SARS-CoV-2 may result in persistent functional impairment after the acute phase of the disease. Emerging evidence suggests that the presence and intensity of COVID-19-related symptoms may be associated with deficits in muscle strength and physical performance during the post-infection period.
